summary: Use VIN as the inventory record ID and verify Windows secret-file ownership and DACL before loading credentials.
reason: TeslaTracker inventory entries may have no generic id, so they must still persist for offline reads. The Windows private-file caller needs a real fail-closed ACL verifier, because POSIX permissions do not secure NTFS files.
validated_outcome: A VIN-only inventory record survives an offline round trip; synthetic SDDL cases reject broad and NULL DACLs; Windows CLI and MCP binaries compile.
